summary: project-map.md starter templates for Web, API-Service, CLI, Mobile, and Desktop platforms. Each template includes all 7 required schema fields (explored_at, build_target, freshness_state, valid_until, entry_points, tech_stack, gaps), 5 standard impact slices (entry-points, api-surface, test-coverage, risk, conventions), Risk Files table, Spec Artifacts, and Conventions section. Scaffold uses these as the initial project-map.md after generation + Explore run.
